title: Metadata compile cache: replace the content digest with a write-moved column on sys_metadata
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oyZgRX9Qc1ZHsMRQp

Follow-up to #34206 (PR #34494, ADR-0156 D5).

## What

The compile cache in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/meta-compile-cache.ts` confirms at each bound (`OS_METADATA_COMPILE_CACHE_TTL_MS`, default 30 s) with `readStoreMark`. That reading is a sha1 digest of every `sys_metadata` row's `id`, `state`, `version`, `checksum`, `updated_at` and stored `metadata`. It reads the whole table, bodies included, because no column on `sys_metadata` moves on every write regardless of the writer's clock. The row count plus the newest `updated_at` missed a peer's write stamped at or before the newest row, an engine-bypassing write that leaves `updated_at` alone, and a timestamp-preserving import (L1 6931948189 M2, contract review 6932160915 S1 on #34494).

## Cost measured

Comment 6933083314 on #34494 has the numbers. The showcase store holds 0 rows, so the bundle readings there do not show this cost. A synthetic run of the same reading through better-sqlite3 (SELECT of the six columns, sort, sha1, without the engine's own per-row work) took:

| rows | body ≈ | median |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 100 | 4 kB | 2.4 ms |
| 1 000 | 4 kB | 23 ms |
| 10 000 | 4 kB | 252 ms |

The cost is linear in the store's size and paid once per bound per engine, on the request that crosses the bound. The seat accepted it for #34494.

## Wanted

A column (or a store-side counter) on `sys_metadata` that every write moves, whatever path it takes and whatever its clock says, so the confirmation can read a small value instead of every body. One shape is a monotonic change sequence bumped by the store on insert, update and delete, including a delete's tombstone, and read as `max` plus count. It has to hold for writes that bypass the engine, which is the class the digest exists for. The current D7 pins in `meta-compile-cache.test.ts` (bookkeeping-preserving bypass, skewed clock, outage, unprovisioned store) must stay green on the new reading.

## Out of scope

The compile cache's counters, stamp rebase, overlay retire and 10-bound age cap stay as #34494 landed them.
